row: ‘bēṭā, tū sadā-taĩ mērē dhōrē sā; kimaĩ mērō tērō dō nāhī sai. Tū-nē̃ bī chāw karᵃṇō thō, ak tērā in bhāī-nē̃ phir-kē janm liyō-sai; ak khūyō, aur phir milyō-sai-gō.
‘son, thou ever-from me-of near art; whatever mine thine two not is. Thee-to also merry-making to-be-done was, that thy this brother-by again birth taken-is; that lost-was, and again (he) found-is.
